subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should session persistence keep the full `systemPromptReport` in every retained session row, or replace it with compact/out-of-line report state while preserving warning dedupe?
rationale: Current source shows the report is intentionally durable for warning dedupe, but field data shows the full payload now dominates `sessions.json`; automation should not choose that persistence contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Compact report persistence
options.body: Store only the load-bearing warning-dedupe state inline and move or recompute bulky report sections such as tools, skills, and injected files.

options.title: Land only skillsSnapshot mitigation
options.body: Treat the linked pull request as a partial mitigation and keep this issue open for a separate `systemPromptReport` design.

options.title: Defer to broad Gateway pressure work
options.body: Leave this focused report unchanged and handle any remaining payload reduction under the broader Gateway session-store pressure tracker.

recommendation.title: Compact report persistence
recommendation.body: Store only the load-bearing warning-dedupe state inline and move or recompute bulky report sections such as tools, skills, and injected files.

likelyOwner.reason: The prompt-report feature history and current session-store persistence path both route most directly through steipete's prior work.
